name: March 5, 2025 Adjourned Special Meeting - Notice of Adjournment
agenda_text:
Notice of Adjournment
  Malibu City Council
  Adjourned Special Meeting

Please take notice that the Adjourned Special City Council Meeting of Wednesday,
March 5, 2025, is hereby adjourned to Thursday, March 6, 2025, at 6:30 p.m.

The Adjourned Special meeting will be held in the Council Chambers at City Hall,
23825 Stuart Ranch Road, Malibu, California 90265.

Should there be any questions regarding this notice, please contact the City Clerk’s
Office at cityclerk@malibucity.org, or (310) 456-2489 ext. 228.

  NOTICE OF CONTINUANCE

Public hearings scheduled for the March 4, 2025 City Council meeting and
continued to the March 5, 2025 Adjourned Special meeting are hereby continued to
the March 6, 2025 Adjourned Special City Council meeting, including:

Local Coastal Program Amendment No. 25-001 and Zoning Text Amendment No.
25-001 – An amendment to the Malibu Local Coastal Program and Malibu
Municipal Code Title 17 (Zoning) Modifying Standards and Procedures to Facilitate
the Rebuilding of Structures Damaged or Destroyed by the 2025 Palisades Fire, 2024
Franklin Fire, and 2024 Broad Fire

Dated: March 5, 2025 at 9:50 p.m.

__________________________________
Kelsey Pettijohn, City Clerk

MINUTES
  MALIBU CITY COUNCIL
  ADJOURNED SPECIAL MEETING
  MARCH 6, 2025
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  6:30 P.M.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Stewart called the meeting to order at 6:32 p.m.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Mayor Doug Stewart; Mayor Pro Tem Marianne  Riggins;  and
  Councilmembers Haylynn Conrad, Bruce Silverstein and Steve Uhring.

  ALSO PRESENT: Trevor Rusin, Interim City Attorney; Alexis Brown, Deputy City
  Manager; Kelsey Pettijohn, City Clerk; Yolanda Bundy, Environmental Sustainability
  Director; Maureen Tamuri, Interim Flaming Director; Parker Davis, Media Technician;
  Tyler Eaton, Principal Planner; Rebecca Evans, Senior Management Analyst; and Patricia
  Salazar, Development and Operations Manager

ITEM 3  ORDINANCES AND PUBLIC HEARINGS

  A.  Local Coastal Program Amendment N0. 25-001 and Zoning Text Amendment No.
  25-001  An amendment to the Malibu Local Coastal Program and Malibu
  Municipal Code Title 17 (Zoning) Modifying Standards and Procedures to
  Facilitate the Rebuilding of Structures Damaged or Destroyed bv the 2025
  Palisades Fire, 2024 Franklin Fire, and 2024 Broad Fire
  Recommended Action: 1) After the City Attomey reads the title of the ordinance,
  adopt Urgency Ordinance No. 524U, approving Zoning Text Amendment No. 25—
  001, an amendment to Title 17 (Zoning) of the Malibu Municipal Code updating
  regulations to facilitate the rebuilding of structures damaged or destroyed by natural
  disasters, including but not limited to, the 2025 Palisades Fire, 2024 Franklin Fire,
  and 2024 Broad Fire to provide relief for those affected, declaring the urgency
  thereof, and finding the amendments are exempt from the California Environmental
  Quality Act; 2) After the City Attomey reads the title of the ordinance, introduce
  on first reading Ordinance No. 524 approving Local Coastal Program Amendment
  No. 25-001, an amendment to the Local Coastal Program and Zoning Text
  Amendment No. 25-001, an amendment to Title 17 (Zoning) of the Malibu
  Municipal Code updating regulations to facilitate the rebuilding of structures
  damaged or destroyed by natural disasters, including but not limited to, the 2025
  Palisades Fire, 2024 Franklin Fire, and 2024 Broad Fire to provide relief for those
  affected, and finding the amendments are exempt from the California
  Environmental Quality Act; and 3) Direct staff to schedule second reading and
  adoption of Ordinance No. 524.

  The public hearing for this item was open and closed on March 5, 2025.
   Malibu City Council

  Councilmamber Conrad, Councilmember Silverstein, and Councilmember Uhring,

  Principal Planner Eaton presented the proposed changes from the March 5, 2025

MOTION  Mayor Pro Tem Riggins moved moved, and Councilmember Conrad seconded a
  motion to: l) After the City Attorney reads the title ofthe ordinance, adopt Urgency
  Ordinance No. 524U, as amended with the changes presented by staff, approving
  Zoning Text Amendment No. 25-001, an amendment to Title 17 (Zoning) of the
  Malibu Municipal Code updating regulations to facilitate the rebuilding of
  structures damaged or destroyed by natural disasters, including but not limited to,
  the 2025 Palisades Fire, 2024 Franklin Fire, and 2024 Broad Fire to provide relief
  for those affected, declaring the urgency thereof, and finding the amendments are
  exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act; 2) After the City Attorney
  reads the title of the ordinance, introduce on first reading Ordinance No. 524, as
  amended with the changes presented by staff, approving Local Coastal Program
  Amendment No. 25-001, an amendment to the Local Coastal Program and Zoning
  Text Amendment No. 25-001, an amendment to Title 17 (Zoning) of the Malibu
  Municipal Code updating regulations to facilitate the rebuilding of structures
  damaged or destroyed by natural disasters, including but not limited to, the 2025
  Palisades Fire, 2024 Franklin Fire, and 2024 Broad Fire to provide relief for those
  affected, and finding the amendments are exempt from the California
  Environmental Quality Act; and 3) Direct staff to schedule second reading and
  adoption of Ordinance No. 524.

  Interim City Attomey Rusin read the titles of Ordinance Nos. 524U and 524

  The question was called and the motion carried 4-1, Councilmember Silverstein
  abstained.

  The Council discussed the process for the ordinance adoption.

ADJOURNMENT

  At 9:18 p.m. Mayor Stewart adj ourned the meeting.
